---
title: "Venn Diagram"
author: "Andrew Becker"
output: html_notebook
date: "2025-01-09"
R_version: "4.4.2"
description: "Creates Venn diagrams to visualize the overlap of proteins across multiple experimental conditions or datasets. Supports 2-way, 3-way, and 4-way comparisons with customizable colors and labels."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries ---
library(Cairo)
library(extrafont)
library(here)
library(VennDiagram)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))
```

```{r visualization_two_way}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Two-sided Venn diagram ---
grid.newpage()  
two.way.venn <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = 1575,
  area2 = 1227,
  cross.area = 613,
  col = c("79380", "800"),
  fill = c("#fc03e8", "#ED1C24"),
  fontfamily = "Arial",
  category.cex = 1,
  category.fontface = "regular",
  euler.d.fontface = "regular",
  euler.d.cex = 1.5,
  lty = "blank",
  cex = 0.8,
  cat.cex = 1)
png(filename = "chol-vs-palm_JF570_venn_14dec24.png", width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 1400)
grid.draw(two.way.venn)
dev.off()
```

```{r visualization_three_way}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Three-way Venn diagram ---
grid.newpage()
venn.plot <- draw.triple.venn(area1 = 485,
                 area2 = 221,
                 area3 = 484,
                 n12 = 165,       
                 n23 = 122,       
                 n13 = 185,
                 n123 = 106,
                 category = c("","",""),
                 fill = c("#be4a80", "#67a5c6", "black"),
                 lty = "blank",
                 cex = 0,
                 cat.cex = 1)
png(filename = "3-way-venn_HDL_cholJF570-heps_7Aug24.png", width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 1400)
grid.draw(venn.plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r visualization_four_way}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Four-way Venn diagram ---
grid.newpage()
venn.plot <- draw.quad.venn(area1 = 587,
                 area2 = 558,
                 area3 = 503,
                 area4 = 754,
                 n12 = 154,       
                 n23 = 347,       
                 n13 = 130,
                 n14 = 236,
                 n24 = 379,
                 n34 = 344,
                 n123 = 100,
                 n124 = 137,
                 n234 = 262,
                 n134 = 122,
                 n1234 = 93,
                 category = c("chol-JF570","LKM38","NBII-165","trans-sterol"),
                 fill = c("#fc03e8", "green", "orange", "blue"),
                 lty = "blank",
                 cex = 2,
                 cat.cex = 1)
grid.draw(venn.plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r visualization_four_way_eps}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Four-way Venn diagram (EPS export for publication) ---
output_file <- "venn_diagram.eps"
Cairo(file = output_file, width = 7, height = 7, type = "eps", units = "in", dpi = 300)

venn.plot <- draw.quad.venn(area1 = 765,
                 area2 = 754,
                 area3 = 503,
                 area4 = 558,
                 n12 = 273,       
                 n23 = 379,       
                 n13 = 142,
                 n14 = 163,
                 n24 = 379,
                 n34 = 347,
                 n123 = 132,
                 n124 = 147,
                 n234 = 262,
                 n134 = 104,
                 n1234 = 102,
                 category = c("chol-JF570","trans-sterol","NBII-165","LKM38"),
                 fill = c("magenta", "dark green", "orange", "blue"),
                 lty = "blank",
                 cat.fontfamily = "Times")

dev.off()
```

```{r export_png}
# --- EXPORT: Save Venn diagram as PNG ---
png(filename = "venn_plot.png", width = 1200, height = 1200, res = 1200)
grid.draw(venn.plot)
dev.off()
```
